english.title: Vehicle defect - cause the use of a motor vehicle / trailer ( not car / van ) with insufficient tyre tread

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLE CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer]_

when the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL POSITION..) wheel was fitted with a pneumatic tyre on which the grooves did not have a depth of at least 1 mm throughout the tread pattern
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For vehicles which require a minimum tread depth of 1.6mm use charge heading no. H149, H150 and H151 (i.e. Cars, vans and light trailers etc.)
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H154 and H160.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
